dedupe_keys.name: adtc insar a tropospheric correction database for andean volcanoes

description: ADTC-InSAR: a tropospheric correction database for Andean volcanoes is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Fernanda Lopez-Pozo et al. Monitoring geophysical hazards requires a near real-time response and precise interpretation of InSAR data, typically recording minute surface deformations. Accurate tropospheric adjustment is an essential aspect of InSAR processing. This study provides a free database of ready-to-use Tropospheric Correction for InSAR for the three volcanic zones from north to south of the Andes. Coverage: not stated; published in 2022. Formats: MATLAB, Python. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
